segments.speaker: Doctor
segments.text: Namaste, baithiye. Bataiye, kya pareshani hai?
segments.english: Hello, please sit. Tell me, what is the problem?

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: Doctor sahab, bukhar hai aur khansi bhi ho rahi hai.
segments.english: Doctor, I have a fever and I have also been coughing.

segments.speaker: Doctor
segments.text: Kitne din se bukhar hai?
segments.english: How many days have you had the fever?

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: Teen din se. Saath mein khansi bhi hai, raat ko zyada hoti hai.
segments.english: For three days. I also have a cough, it gets worse at night.

segments.speaker: Doctor
segments.text: Balgam aata hai? Saans lene mein koi takleef?
segments.english: Do you bring up phlegm? Any difficulty breathing?

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: Nahi, sookhi khansi hai. Saans theek hai.
segments.english: No, it is a dry cough. Breathing is fine.

segments.speaker: Doctor
segments.text: Kisi dawai se allergy hai?
segments.english: Are you allergic to any medicine?

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: Nahi, koi allergy nahi hai.
segments.english: No, I have no allergies.

segments.speaker: Doctor
segments.text: Temperature 101 hai, pulse 96. Chest clear hai.
segments.english: Temperature is 101, pulse 96. Chest is clear.

segments.speaker: Doctor
segments.text: Paracetamol 650 lijiye, din mein teen baar, teen din tak, khaana khaane ke baad.
segments.english: Take Paracetamol 650, three times a day for three days, after food.

segments.speaker: Doctor
segments.text: Paani zyada peejiye aur aaram kijiye. Agar bukhar teen din mein nahi utarta, toh CBC karwa ke dikhaiye.
segments.english: Drink plenty of water and rest. If the fever does not come down in three days, get a CBC done and come back.

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: Theek hai doctor sahab, dhanyavaad.
segments.english: Okay doctor, thank you.

chief_complaints.details: Worse at night; no sputum; no breathing difficulty

follow_up.text: Review if fever persists, with CBC report

draft.summary: Fever and dry cough for 3 days; temperature 101 °F, chest clear. Symptomatic treatment, CBC if fever persists.

segments.speaker: Doctor
segments.text: Ramesh ji, kaise hain? Sugar ki report laaye hain?
segments.english: Ramesh ji, how are you? Did you bring the sugar report?

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: Haan doctor, fasting 168 aaya hai. Dawai time pe le raha hoon.
segments.english: Yes doctor, fasting came out 168. I am taking my medicine on time.

segments.speaker: Doctor
segments.text: Metformin 500 subah-shaam chal rahi hai na? Pet mein koi problem?
segments.english: You are on Metformin 500 morning and evening, right? Any stomach problems?

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: Haan, wahi le raha hoon. Pet theek hai. Bas kabhi kabhi sar mein dard rehta hai.
segments.english: Yes, I am taking that. Stomach is fine. Just sometimes I get a headache.

segments.speaker: Doctor
segments.text: BP 152 by 96 hai, thoda high hai. Weight 82 kilo.
segments.english: BP is 152 over 96, a bit high. Weight 82 kilos.

segments.speaker: Doctor
segments.text: Metformin 1000 kar dete hain, din mein do baar, khaane ke baad. Aur Amlodipine 5 mg roz subah ek goli.
segments.english: Let us increase Metformin to 1000, twice a day after food. And Amlodipine 5 mg, one tablet every morning.

segments.speaker: Doctor
segments.text: HbA1c aur fasting sugar dobara karwaiye. Namak kam kijiye, roz aadha ghanta walk kijiye.
segments.english: Get HbA1c and fasting sugar repeated. Reduce salt and walk half an hour every day.

segments.speaker: Doctor
segments.text: Ek mahine baad reports ke saath aaiye.
segments.english: Come back after a month with the reports.

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: Ji, theek hai.
segments.english: Yes, okay.

segments.text: Dictation for Arjun Mehta, twenty-seven year old male.

segments.text: Complains of sore throat and mild fever for two days, with pain on swallowing. No cough.

segments.speaker: Doctor
segments.text: On examination, temperature 100.4, SpO2 98 percent. Throat congested, tonsils enlarged without exudate.

segments.speaker: Doctor
segments.text: Impression: acute pharyngitis.

segments.speaker: Doctor
segments.text: Tablet Paracetamol 500 mg SOS for fever, maximum three tablets a day. Warm saline gargles three times a day.

segments.speaker: Doctor
segments.text: Review after three days if not better. End of dictation.
